title: 第11章 下马威
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

前哨营虽然不大，但也有七八号弟兄。

自己新官上任，按规矩，底下的人都该出来露个脸。

王小虎脸上的笑容僵了一下，支支吾吾道，“他们……都在外面执行任务。”

执行任务？

林珝把眼一眯，自己这个临时头目还没走马上任，谁给的任务？

他没追问，只是看着王小虎那副尴尬的表情，心里已经有了答案。

看来这帮土匪油子，是准备给自己一个下马威啊。

林珝早就不是职场小白了，前世他在横店跑过三年龙套，剧组的勾心斗角没少见。

主角压配角、老人欺新人，和眼下这一出比起来，本质上没什么区别。

只不过这里的规矩不是排资论辈，是拳头。

“王小虎！”

林珝把脸一沉，拔高语调，用不容置疑的口吻发布了第一条命令，

“你去，把所有人召集起来，就说伍正到任，让所有人返回大营，谁敢不听命令，就按山寨规矩处置。”

“这……”

王小虎面露难色，还在迟疑，林珝直接解下令牌，丢到王小虎怀里，

“一个时辰，如果延期，所有前哨弟兄各领二十板子，罚奉三个月！”

“是！”王小虎打了个激灵，看出林珝没开玩笑，赶紧领了命，一溜烟跑了出去。

林珝走进帐篷，拉了把椅子坐下，翘起二郎腿，手指在膝盖上轻轻敲打着，默默计算时间。

第一天上任就遇上这种事，很难说是巧合，还是有人在暗处算计。

一个时辰后，七八个懒散的土匪油子，总算跟着王小虎回了营帐。

林珝坐在椅子上没动，斜眼扫向他们。

这群人个个神情懒撒，有人打着哈欠、甚至有人还在系裤腰带，愣是没一个拿正眼看自己。

林珝把眼角眯起来，目光越过前面几个人，落在最后进来的那个人身上。

心里又是一咯噔。

入眼处，那颗锃光瓦亮的大光头在帐篷里格外扎眼，太阳穴上的旧刀疤被帐内的油灯照得发亮。

此时的老光中慢悠悠地晃进来，双手抱胸，站在人群最后面，嘴角挂着一丝似笑非笑的弧度。

“又是这个家伙！”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Although the outpost camp is not big, there are still brothers No. 78.

When he takes office as a new official, according to the rules, all the people below him should come out and show their faces.

The smile on Wang Xiaohu's face froze, and he hesitated, "They... are all performing tasks outside."

On a mission?

Lin Jue squinted her eyes. As the interim leader, he hadn't yet taken office. Who gave him the task?

He didn't ask further questions, just looked at Wang Xiaohu's embarrassed expression and already had the answer in his heart.

It seems that these bandits are preparing to give themselves a blow.

Lin Jue is no longer a newbie in the workplace. In his previous life, he worked as a bit player in Hengdian for three years, and intrigues among the crew were not uncommon.

The protagonist dominates the supporting role, and the old bullies the newcomer. Compared with the current show, there is essentially no difference.

It's just that the rules here are not based on seniority, but fists.

"Wang Xiaohu!"

Lin Jue lowered her face, raised her tone, and issued the first order in an unquestionable tone.

"Go, gather everyone together, tell Wu Zheng to take office, and ask everyone to return to the camp. Anyone who dares to disobey orders will be dealt with according to the rules of the village."

"This..."

Wang Xiaohu looked confused and was still hesitating. Lin Jue immediately removed the sign and threw it into Wang Xiaohu's arms.

"One hour, if it is delayed, all the outpost brothers will each receive twenty pieces of board and be punished for three months!"

"Yes!" Wang Xiaohu trembled and saw that Lin Jue was not joking. He quickly took the order and ran out quickly.

Lin Jue walked into the tent, pulled up a chair and sat down, crossed her legs, tapped her fingers lightly on her knees, and counted the time silently.

This happened to me on my first day in office. It's hard to say whether it was a coincidence or someone was plotting in the dark.

An hour later, seven or eight lazy bandits, Youzi, finally followed Wang Xiaohu back to the camp.

Lin Jue sat still on the chair and glanced at them sideways.

Everyone in this group looked lazy, some were yawning, and some were even fastening their belts, but no one looked at him seriously.

Lin Jue narrowed the corners of her eyes, looked past the people in front of her, and landed on the person who came in last.

My heart skipped a beat again.

The big, shiny bald head that caught his eye was particularly eye-catching in the tent, and the old scar on his temple was illuminated by the oil lamp inside the tent.

At this time, Lao Guangzhong swayed in slowly, with his arms folded across his chest, standing at the back of the crowd, with a hint of a smile on his lips.

"It's this guy again!"
